description: Collection and presentation of data using frequency distribution tables, measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and range for raw and grouped data, and statistical graphs including histograms, frequency polygons and the cumulative frequency curve (ogive).

mcq.questionText: What is the mode of the data set: 4, 7, 7, 2, 9, 7, 4?
mcq.explanation: The mode is the value that appears most often. The value 7 appears three times, more than any other.

mcq.questionText: Find the range of the data: 12, 5, 18, 9, 21, 7.
What is the mean of the numbers 6, 10, 14, 8, 12?
Find the median of the data set: 3, 8, 1, 6, 9.
mcq.explanation: Arranged in order: 1, 3, 6, 8, 9. The middle value (3rd of 5) is 6.

mcq.questionText: Find the median of the data set: 4, 11, 7, 2, 9, 5.
mcq.explanation: Ordered: 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11. With 6 values the median is the mean of the 3rd and 4th: (5 + 7) / 2 = 6.

mcq.questionText: In a frequency distribution table, what does the frequency of a value represent?

options.text: The sum of all the values
The number of times that value occurs
The largest value in the data

mcq.explanation: Frequency is a count of how many times a particular value or class occurs in the data.

mcq.questionText: The scores 5, 6, 7, 8 have frequencies 2, 3, 4, 1 respectively. What is the mean score?
Which graph is used to display the cumulative frequency of grouped data?
mcq.explanation: The cumulative frequency curve is called an ogive; it plots cumulative frequency against the upper class boundaries.

mcq.questionText: For the class interval 20 - 29, what is the class mark (mid-value)?
For the class interval 10 - 19, what is the class size (width) using class boundaries?
mcq.explanation: Boundaries are 9.5 and 19.5, so the class size = 19.5 - 9.5 = 10.

mcq.questionText: In a histogram of grouped data with equal class widths, what is plotted on the vertical axis?
mcq.explanation: For equal class widths the heights of the bars represent the frequency of each class.

mcq.questionText: The mean of 5 numbers is 14. If a sixth number 26 is added, what is the new mean?
mcq.explanation: Original sum = 5 x 14 = 70; new sum = 70 + 26 = 96; new mean = 96 / 6 = 16.

mcq.questionText: Which measure of central tendency is most affected by an extreme (very large) value?
mcq.explanation: The mean uses every value in its calculation, so an extreme value (outlier) pulls it strongly; the median and mode are resistant to outliers.

mcq.questionText: From a cumulative frequency table, the cumulative frequency up to 'less than 40' is 18 and up to 'less than 50' is 27. How many values lie in the class 40 - 49?
mcq.explanation: The class frequency = difference of cumulative frequencies = 27 - 18 = 9.

mcq.questionText: The total frequency of a distribution is 50. Using an ogive, the median corresponds to which cumulative frequency value?
mcq.explanation: On an ogive the median is read at a cumulative frequency of N/2 = 50/2 = 25.

fib.questionText: The value that occurs most frequently in a set of data is called the _____.
fib.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value in a data set.

fib.questionText: The difference between the highest and lowest values in a data set is called the _____.
fib.explanation: Range = highest value - lowest value, a simple measure of spread.

fib.questionText: The mean of the numbers 3, 7, 11, 15, 19 is _____.
When data values are arranged in order, the middle value is called the _____.
fib.explanation: The median is the central value of an ordered data set.

fib.questionText: For the class interval 30 - 39, the class mark (mid-value) is _____.
The graph formed by joining the mid-points of the tops of histogram bars with straight lines is called a frequency _____.
fib.explanation: A frequency polygon joins the class marks (or tops of bars) with straight line segments.

fib.questionText: The cumulative frequency curve is also known as an _____.
fib.explanation: The ogive plots cumulative frequency against the upper class boundaries.

fib.questionText: If the mean of 8 numbers is 12, then the sum of the 8 numbers is _____.
fib.explanation: Sum = mean x number of values = 12 x 8 = 96.

fib.questionText: The median of the data set 14, 9, 21, 6, 18, 11 is _____.
For the class interval 50 - 59, the lower class boundary is _____.
fib.explanation: The lower class boundary is found by subtracting 0.5 from the lower limit: 50 - 0.5 = 49.5.

tf.questionText: The mode of a data set can be more than one value.
tf.explanation: If two or more values share the highest frequency the data is bimodal or multimodal.

tf.questionText: The mean of a data set must always be one of the values in the data set.
tf.explanation: The mean is a calculated average and need not equal any actual data value, for example the mean of 2 and 5 is 3.5.

tf.questionText: The range is a measure of how spread out the data is.
tf.explanation: The range measures spread (dispersion) as the difference between the highest and lowest values.

tf.questionText: In a histogram with equal class widths the bars are drawn with gaps between them.
tf.explanation: Histogram bars are drawn touching each other because the data is continuous.

tf.questionText: When a data set has an even number of values, the median is the average of the two middle values.
tf.explanation: For an even number of ordered values the median is the mean of the two central values.

tf.questionText: The cumulative frequency of the last class equals the total number of observations.
tf.explanation: Cumulative frequency adds up all frequencies, so the final value equals the total frequency N.

tf.questionText: The mean is the best measure of central tendency to use when the data contains extreme outliers.
tf.explanation: The mean is strongly affected by outliers, so the median is usually preferred when extreme values are present.

tf.questionText: A frequency distribution table organises data by showing each value or class together with its frequency.
tf.explanation: A frequency distribution table lists values or class intervals alongside how often each occurs.

tf.questionText: On an ogive, the cumulative frequency is plotted against the lower class boundaries.
tf.explanation: An ogive plots cumulative frequency against the upper class boundaries, since the cumulative count is reached at the top of each class.

tf.questionText: For grouped data, the modal class is the class interval with the highest frequency.
tf.explanation: The modal class is the interval that contains the greatest number of observations.

summary.correctAnswer: Sum of all values divided by the number of values.
summary.explanation: Mean = (sum of values) / (number of values); it uses every data value.

summary.correctAnswer: The middle value of data arranged in order.
summary.explanation: For an even count, it is the average of the two middle values; unaffected by outliers.

summary.correctAnswer: The value that occurs most often.
summary.explanation: A data set can have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode at all.
The range is a simple measure of how spread out the data is.

summary.correctAnswer: The number of times a value or class occurs.
summary.explanation: Frequencies are recorded in a frequency distribution table.

summary.correctAnswer: The mid-value of a class interval.
summary.explanation: Class mark = (lower limit + upper limit) / 2; used to estimate the mean of grouped data.

summary.correctAnswer: The running total of frequencies up to a given class.
summary.explanation: It is used to draw the ogive and to estimate the median of grouped data.

summary.correctAnswer: A graph of touching bars showing the frequency of class intervals.
summary.explanation: Used for continuous grouped data; bar heights show frequency when class widths are equal.

summary.correctAnswer: A line graph joining the class marks plotted against frequency.
summary.explanation: It is formed by joining the mid-points of the tops of histogram bars with straight lines.
Plots cumulative frequency against upper class boundaries; used to read the median and quartiles.

hoq.questionText: The marks of 40 students are grouped as follows: 0-9 (4), 10-19 (10), 20-29 (14), 30-39 (8), 40-49 (4). Using class marks, estimate the mean mark.
A data set of 7 numbers has a mean of 10. Six of the numbers are 8, 12, 9, 11, 7 and 13. What is the seventh number?
hoq.explanation: Total required = 7 x 10 = 70; sum of six given = 8+12+9+11+7+13 = 60; seventh number = 70 - 60 = 10.

hoq.questionText: The cumulative frequencies for classes with upper boundaries 9.5, 19.5, 29.5, 39.5 are 5, 17, 33, 40 respectively. Using N/2, which class contains the median?
hoq.explanation: N = 40 so N/2 = 20. The cumulative frequency first reaches or passes 20 in the class 20 - 29 (cumulative 33, since the previous class only reached 17).
